description: PC_ERMSE (1) / (2): per-dataset targets and weights over a local config.val.

evaluations.note: 9: BFGS reaches the upper bound RCUT2B = 6 at eval 7 and takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 8-9); its next step cannot move the point, so the line search is not run and the objective-delta test ends the search. The loss has no PC_LAMMPS line, so a point asked for again would be answered from its evaluation; none is.

tolerance_rationale: Bundle is bit-deterministic when SEED is set; tolerances absorb cross-machine BLAS/LAPACK reorder and FP printf rounding while still flagging a material regression.
